result.title: Semantic-Guided Geometric Decoding for Token-Efficient Visual Grounding
result.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a unified interface for language-conditioned visual perception. In pixel-to-sequence grounding, autoregressive coordinate generation requires multiple sequential decoding steps per box, increasing inference cost with the number of instances. Pixel-to-embedding methods reduce this overhead but lack explicit spatial encoding when using a shared special token. We introduce SemGeo, a token-efficient visual grounding framework that represents each instance with a single grid token for coarse localization. A geometric decoder reuses visual features and hidden states to recover precise discrete box coordinates in parallel. To train proposal generation and box localization together, we introduce Gaussian soft labels that encode coordinate distances during supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Reinforcement post-training further combines box-set rewards with coordinate supervision on model-generated proposals. This stage trains the language model and geometric decoder on their own predictions to mitigate the mismatch between teacher-forced training and inference. Across eight benchmarks spanning object detection, referring object detection, and document layout grounding, SemGeo achieves the highest F1@mIou among compared MLLMs on six benchmarks. It also delivers $2.07\times$ and $1.25\times$ the mean box-generation throughput of representative grounding baselines under vLLM and Transformers, respectively, while achieving higher accuracy in both comparisons.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SemGeo，用单个 grid token 做实例粗定位，再由几何解码器复用视觉特征与隐藏状态并行回归离散框坐标，并结合 Gaussian 软标签和基于框集合奖励的强化后训练来对齐训练与推理。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及视觉几何信息在内部状态中的保留与并行坐标生成，其“隐状态复用解码”和软标签监督可供核查 LVR 中空间表示、token 效率及训练-推理分布错配问题。
